item.title: WinUI 3 developer digest — October 3, 2026
item.description: WinUI 3 developer digest — October 3, 2026 Latest-day focus: Oct 2, 08:32:01 → Oct 3, 08:32:01 PDT. Seven-day catch-up: Sept 26–Oct 3; continuing the initial catch-up because earlier overall coverage was partial. Previously reported items are deduplicated. A shipping community control fills another gap: RibbonSpace now supports plain WinUI 3, with concrete porting lessons rather than just screenshots. Fresh repros make old bugs more actionable: image-file locking depends on URI scheme; a WMC9999 failure narrows to static method overload discovery. Experimental still means experimental: a new 2.5.4 ItemsView crash report has a suggested timing workaround, not a confirmed fix. Community experience RibbonSpace 1.1.0 brings an Office-style ribbon to plain WinUI 3 — Wiesław Šoltés / GitHub, Oct 3. RibbonSpace.WinUI shares controls, MVVM, themes, KeyTips and backstage code with the Uno version

item.title: WinUI 3 developer-community digest — October 2, 2026
item.description: WinUI 3 developer-community digest — October 2, 2026 Coverage: October 1, 08:30 → October 2, 08:30 PDT. Seven-day catch-up searches; previously reported stories excluded. Overall coverage is partial. Takeaways Packaging gets tangible fixes: a published MSIX BuildTools update addresses resource/publish failures—not merely a promised source change. Practical gotchas: scope WindowsAppSDKSelfContained to the executable, and don’t equate successful notification calls with visible toasts. Input performance: fresh ColorPicker reports implicate high mouse polling rates; users provide a mitigation and debugging evidence, not a confirmed framework fix. Community experience SimpleFiles: a student ships a native file manager. Reddit r/SideProject, October 1.
